title: Register as a domestic builder
what: Register with the Building and Plumbing Commission before taking on domestic building contracts worth more than $10,000 (or any re-blocking, re-stumping or demolition).

sources.title: Building Act 1993 (Vic)
sources.publisher: Victorian Legislation (authorised version saved by the owner)
sources.locator: s 169F(1) (authorised version 152, saved by the owner)
sources.quote: (1) A person must not carry out domestic building work under a major domestic building contract unless the person is a registered builder or a licensed building employee.

sources.title: Becoming a registered building practitioner
sources.quote: You must register with the Building and Plumbing Commission (BPC) if you work in domestic building in Victoria and either: handle a contract worth more than $10,000
